question: Can selves of conscious nature be covered by concealment of knowability?
premises: Selves, being of the nature of consciousness, do not admit knowability as objects.
Covering as concealment of knowability presupposes object-knowability.
Applying such covering to selves is not even verbally coherent.
inference: The notion of covering selves by concealment of knowability is incoherent.
plain_english: But selves, because they are of the nature of consciousness, do not admit knowability; so to speak of their being covered is not fitting even in words.
